force_model: F = m*a + m*g*sin(theta) + Crr*m*g*cos(theta); traction power max(F*v, 0)/eta; no regeneration; constant auxiliary load

planning_assumptions.provenance: speed/acceleration caps and rotation rate are frozen fixture and Nav2 controller settings; the per-goal transition allowance is a declared planning constant derived from the accepted Phase 1 repeated-run series mission windows (11.6-19.7 s overhead per intermediate goal including route-B rotations), not a fitted parameter

calibration.data: phase-0 qualification ramp matrix (36 complete fresh-world trials)
calibration.observed_label: modeled electrical Wh recomputed from raw actuator traces under the frozen Phase 1 telemetry accounting model
calibration.method: rolling-resistance grid with analytic bounded least squares for (1/eta, auxiliary); complete-run separation

scope_limits: Calibrated against modeled simulated telemetry, not physical battery measurements.
Valid only for the frozen warehouse fixture, robot, payloads, and surfaces.
Waypoint transition and rotation demand are declared planning allowances; their residual error is Stage 3B residual-learning material.
